serve.description: The Nx face of the stack-free dev engine (`tools/dev/dev serve <app>`), on two targets. `<app>:serve` (what `nx serve <app>` runs) is NOT continuous: Nx never shares a non-continuous task, so every `nx serve` is its OWN stack and ends with the stack's own exit status (0 on a clean stop, non-zero naming the process that died). `<app>:dev-stack` is the same executor, continuous — only for an e2e target to depend on (Nx shares it, which is right there). The engine runs every process the app declares in `.bespunky/dev.json` (the dev-server; the Firebase emulator suite in a Firebase workspace; anything hand-declared) under ONE graceful Ctrl+C, for the current git worktree or any chosen one (--worktree=<branch|slug|path>), on one port offset for every declared port (--port-offset=auto|<n>: the main tree prefers the base ports, each other stack a verified-free, claimed block sized from the declaration), reached at `<slug>.localhost` in the shared co-driven browser (--no-shared-browser to serve headless). --skip=<id,…> leaves processes out (--no-emulators is --skip=emulators; the app then opens with ?emulate=none). Options it does not own are forwarded to the app's primary process (buildTarget, host, proxyConfig, ssl, …); --configuration picks the dev-server's build. --dry-run prints the plan.
